title: bazis-design/1: spec/design/theme.yaml
description: The design of the frontend: the preset of its shell and its options; an option that is not given is that of the preset. The tokens are layers: those of the starters that `palette`, `fonts`, `shape` and `surface` name, then those of spec/design/tokens.json over them; together they must define every token that the preset requires. `manage.py bazis_front design` compiles both into frontend/src/bazis/generated/theme.css and theme.ts.

preset.description: workspace: the shell of a working application (a sidebar, dense tables, forms in dialogs); portal: a public shell (a top bar, larger type, cards, forms on pages).

palette.description: The colors of both modes, a starter of the package: indigo, forest (green on warm paper), ember (warm orange), slate (quiet blue-grey), ocean (teal), plum, pine (dark spruce on linen with a clay brand, a dark sidebar), frost (cool paper with a cedar primary and a honey brand, a dark cedar sidebar, the glow of the paper).

fonts.description: The fonts of the text and of the headings, a pair of the package shipped with the frontend (system: the fonts of the system; golos: Golos Text alone, a grotesque; literata-golos: Golos Text with headings in Literata; both served by the frontend itself), or a family of Google Fonts loaded from its stylesheet: {google: "Inter:wght@400..700"}.

shape.description: The radius of the corners: sharp 0.25rem, soft 0.5rem, round 0.875rem.

surface.description: The shadows of the cards, the popovers and the dialogs: flat (almost none), bordered (the borders with the light shadows of Tailwind), elevated (soft layered shadows), lifted (no borders: the surfaces and the controls lifted by shadows in the tone of the paper, the fields a bottom line).

mode.description: both: the light and the dark mode, switched by the user (the default; the light mode only without tokens of the group `dark`); light or dark: that mode only.

density.description: The spacing of the pages, the cards and the rows of the tables (comfortable by default).

list.description: A list as a table (workspace) or a grid of cards (portal).

list_phone.description: A list on a phone: cards (the default), or as on a wide screen (a table scrolls sideways).

list_card.description: split: the list and the card side by side on a wide screen (workspace); pages: the card replaces the list (portal).

forms.description: Forms in a dialog (workspace) or in place of the content of the screen (portal).

filters.description: The row of the filters of a list, a board or a calendar: plate (the default), on a surface of its own; row, on the page without it.

list_tools.description: The search, the view and the actions of a list: list (the default), in the toolbar over it; header, in the header of its screen beside the title, the filters staying over the list. `header.search` of a screen chooses for it.

sidebar.description: The sidebar until the user chooses (his choice is kept by the browser): auto (the default), expanded on a wide screen and a rail of icons below the breakpoint lg; expanded, at every width; rail, a rail of icons at every width. Only with `navigation: sidebar` (D018).

date.description: The input of a date: localized (the default), a text as the language of the product writes a date (`02.11.2026`) with a calendar; native, `<input type="date">` of the browser, its own picker on a phone, in the language of the browser. Either takes `YYYY-MM-DD` from the end-to-end tests.

statuses.description: The tone of the badge of each status of bazis-statusy, by the id of the status; a status that is not here is neutral.

brand.description: The mark of the brand next to the name of the product in the shell, on `color.brand`: a lucide icon (lucide.dev, in kebab-case), or an image of frontend/public/ by its path there (`brand/mark.svg`). Without it, the first letter of the name.

icons.description: The icon of each entity, by the id of the entity: the name of a lucide icon (lucide.dev), in kebab-case.
